subject: Possible delay with airport pickup
text: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I am writing about the shared car to the airport next Friday morning, because there may be a small problem that requires adjusting our plan. The repair shop just informed me that the replacement part for my car will not arrive until later in the day, so I cannot drive as originally promised. I am very sorry for the late notice. Would it be possible for you to take my bag, if it will fit in your trunk, and for me to meet you at the terminal instead? Alternatively, I can arrange a rideshare, but I would still appreciate help with the suitcase and early parking. I have already sent the updated itinerary, so you can see the revised time and gate number there. If that plan does not work, I will try to secure another ride, though your help would make the day much calmer. Please let me know what feels easiest, and thank you so much for being flexible. Kind regards,
